data.summary: Results-driven IT and Finance Process professional with 4.10 years of experience in IT Service Desk operations and Supply Chain Finance. Proven track record of independently managing end-to-end buyer programs, optimizing workflows, and delivering exceptional client support. Expertise in process coordination, technical troubleshooting, Active Directory, ServiceNow, and financial documentation. Adept at managing multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high quality standards and meeting tight deadlines.

raw_sections.summary: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Results-driven IT and Finance Process professional with 4.10 years of experience in IT Service Desk operations and Supply Chain Finance. Proven track record of independently managing end-to-end buyer programs, optimizing workflows, and delivering exceptional client support. Expertise in process coordination, technical troubleshooting, Active Directory, ServiceNow, and financial documentation. Adept at managing multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high quality standards and meeting tight deadlines.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Process Lead - Supply Chain Finance Capgemini - MUFG Bank (Magellan)
January 2023 – Present Bengaluru, India
Independently designed and executed complete setup packages for buyer programs across multiple countries, including supplier agreements, RPA configuration, margin rates, and fee structures
Served as primary point of contact for clients, gathering requirements, resolving concerns, and delivering customized solutions aligned with business needs
Managed buyer program customization ensuring compliance with contractual agreements and local regulations across different geographic markets
Developed optional discounting packages and additional buyer forms with 100% accuracy in documentation
Conducted comprehensive package reviews with clients, incorporating feedback and implementing improve- ments to enhance process efficiency
Coordinated end-to-end workflow from package creation through supplier enrollment to SCF backend process- ing
Ensured all documentation met internal policies and external regulatory compliance standards before submis- sion
Successfully managed multiple concurrent projects independently, consistently meeting quality standards and deadlines
Provided strategic feedback based on client interactions to optimize package quality and operational efficiency
Maintained precise documentation for all financial elements including margin calculations and fee structures
Software Analyst - IT Service Desk Capgemini - Zebra Technologies & MUFG Bank
June 2021 – December 2022 Bengaluru, India
Provided comprehensive IT service desk support for Zebra Technologies and MUFG Bank, managing high- volume tickets, customer support chats, and technical calls
Administered MS Office licenses using admin access, ensuring seamless allocation and access control for clients
Demonstrated expertise in Active Directory for user management, permissions, and security group adminis- tration
Performed technical troubleshooting via remote sessions, achieving effective and timely resolution of incidents
Utilized ServiceNow platform for accurate incident documentation, tracking, and reporting
Escalated high-priority incidents (P2, P3, X-Matter) and collaborated with Level 2/3 support teams to identify root causes and implement proactive solutions
Acted as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Team Lead’s absence, managing ticket queues and delegating tasks effectively
Successfully managed MUFG account migration period, ensuring smooth domain conversion with minimal disruption
Created VPN certificates and Distribution Lists using Active Directory for secure access management
Categorized, recorded, and resolved reported queries while maintaining comprehensive service desk reports
Monitored incidents from initiation through resolution, escalating unresolved issues to appropriate stakeholders
Managed support requests across multiple channels including email, chat, and telephone
raw_sections.education:
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Commerce CMR University Pre-University (12th Grade) St. Joseph’s Pre-University College
2018 – 2021 Bengaluru, Karnataka 2016 – 2018 Bengaluru, Karnataka
raw_sections.skills: TECHNICAL SKILLS IT & Software: Active Directory, ServiceNow, MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), VPN Configuration, Remote Support Tools, RPA Process & Finance: Supply Chain Finance, Process Coordination, Workflow Optimization, Compli- ance Management, Documentation, Client Relationship Management Technical Support: Incident Management, Troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis, User Account Management, License Administration, Migration Support Soft Skills: Communication, Self-Motivation, Time Management, Problem-Solving, Client Manage- ment, Independent Work, Multi-tasking
